Fund-level mechanism: wrapper source_encodings.position_identity_contexts, entries "<accession> <context> => <key>", makes _guarded_union refuse a union across different keys. To declare in a follow-up (needs a 7th build: follow-up run): 0001872371-26-000004 c-366, 0001872371-26-000009 c-361, 0001872371-26-000013 c-366 => spruce-jpy-term-loan-3; 0001872371-26-000009 c-360 and 0001872371-26-000013 c-363 => spruce-usd-revolver; 0001872371-25-000014 c-349 and 0001872371-25-000018 c-343 => spruce-jpy-term-loan-1; 0001872371-25-000018 c-345, 0001872371-26-000004 c-365, 0001872371-26-000009 c-359, 0001872371-26-000013 c-364, 0001872371-25-000014 c-347, 0001872371-25-000008 c-339 => spruce-usd-term-loan-116m; 0001872371-25-000008 c-338, 0001872371-25-000014 c-348 => spruce-cad-term-loan; 0001872371-26-000004 c-98 (and earlier CD&R GBP term loan contexts) => cdr-firefly-gbp-term-loan; 0001872371-26-000009 c-104 and 0001872371-26-000013 c-112 => buttercup-clo-notes.
Not done: no sixth-plus build was available (6 of 6 used); the keys above are untested.

request_resolution_history.why: The supplementary position_key edges go through _guarded_union, which refuses unions that cross the keys declared in the wrapper source_encodings.position_identity_contexts (live in the 0001918712 wrapper). The chain fixes are parked below for a follow-up build; no shared change is requested.
